title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 85 (Sylvester Road)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Sylvester Road
85 That portion of Fraser Valley Regional District being 50 m either side of the centreline of Sylvester Road between the midline of Farms Road and the midline of Dale Road. [en. B.C. Reg. 172/86, s. 2; am. B.C. Reg. 235/97, s. 3 (d).]
